author: Akien
prose:
[2026-09-15, on the tester's mail piling in the bus and troubles raised by fixture proofs] my first 3 notions about fixing this were about how to ISOLATE THE PROBLEM. And I realized that's what biology does as a last resort. it'll try and integrate and adapt first. we need to make us resiliant to testing noise.

like testing messages over the bus. if they're all flagged, then only test handlers need to pay attention. the shims otherwise dispose of the debris. same with trouble tickets. trouble tickets from testing trouble tickets even! but if EVERYTHING involved in testing is thusly flagged, then we just build the resiliance.

[on where a tester run lives] /.cairn/devices/tester/0/runs/<run>/ i think becomes /.cairn/logging/devices/tester/0/runs/<run>/ (or whatever the logging path would be for tester, i forget) because that's where we auto-recycle-after-30-days

[on CC's read-back of the mark as physics, contagion, and the measurement] i think we're in accord on that one.
